articles.title: Royal Caribbean Group Reports Q3 2026 Results, Raises Full-Year Guidance
articles.summary: Royal Caribbean beat its own third-quarter forecast and raised its outlook for the year.
articles.recap: Royal Caribbean Group posted third-quarter earnings of $6.45 per share, or $6.57 adjusted, ahead of what it had predicted. The company credited strong last-minute bookings and some costs landing later than planned. It now expects full-year adjusted earnings of $17.85 to $17.95 per share. Higher fuel prices and currency moves took a little off the gain.

articles.title: Villa Vie Residential Ship Enters Lay Up Due to Financial Issues
articles.summary: Villa Vie's Odyssey has stopped sailing in Asia after the company couldn't pay for fuel.
articles.recap: Villa Vie Residences says its ship Odyssey is in a temporary lay up in the Far East. The CEO told residents the company couldn't get the fuel it needed, so residents were asked to leave the ship in Cambodia. Crew are staying aboard to look after the vessel. Residents say the company had repeatedly asked them for extra money beforehand, including a recent request for $360,000 for fuel.

articles.title: TUI Cancels Mein Schiff 3 Canaries Cruise After Bremerhaven Collision
articles.summary: A storm pushed Mein Schiff 3 into two cargo ships in Germany, and its Canaries trip is cancelled.
articles.recap: Mein Schiff 3 was leaving Bremerhaven in strong winds on October 25 when a gust pushed it into a small container ship and then the larger MSC Victorine. The cruise ship's lifeboats, their cranes and its hull were damaged. About 2,400 guests got off the next morning, and TUI says nobody was hurt. The ship stays in port for repairs, so its Canary Islands cruise won't go ahead.

articles.title: Explora III Makes Miami Debut to Kick Off Winter Caribbean Program
articles.summary: Explora Journeys' newest ship has arrived in Miami for its first Caribbean winter.
articles.recap: Explora III reached Miami on October 25 and was welcomed with a plaque ceremony at PortMiami. The 922-guest ship will sail from Florida, Puerto Rico and Barbados through early April 2027. After that it heads to the West Coast for the brand's first Alaska season. Explora IV is due in spring 2027, with two more ships to follow.

articles.title: Virgin Cancels 2027 Cruise on the West Coast
articles.summary: Virgin Voyages dropped an October 2027 Mexican Riviera sailing to make way for a private charter.
articles.recap: Brilliant Lady's seven-night Los Angeles roundtrip, set to start October 30, 2027, has been cancelled for a private charter. It would have called at San Diego, Cabo San Lucas and Ensenada. Booked guests can reportedly switch to another seven-night LA sailing between mid-September and mid-November 2027 at the same fare. Virgin is also adding a $100 onboard credit.

articles.title: Viking Unveils 19-Day Grand Nile Journey
articles.summary: Viking has a new, longer Egypt trip starting in 2028.
articles.recap: Viking's new Grand Nile Journey runs 19 days, with four nights in a Cairo hotel and a 14-night cruise to Aswan. It sails on the Viking Ra, a 52-guest ship built for the Nile. The trip has 17 guided tours, including the Giza pyramids and sites in Middle Egypt that fewer visitors see. Bookings are open now.

articles.title: Stena Inks Deal to Acquire Color Line
articles.summary: Stena, owner of Stena Line, is buying Norwegian ferry company Color Line.
articles.recap: Stena AB has agreed to buy Color Line from the Sunde family, which owns it through its holding company. The price wasn't disclosed, and the deal still needs regulators' approval. It is expected to close in the first half of 2027. Color Line will keep its own brand, Norwegian management and Norwegian-flagged ships.
